{{Quote|You've been assigned a family tent in section two-four-one. Bedding and cooking utensils are in the tent.|A trooper of the Arkinnea Militia assigns K'Kruhk's group to section two-four-one|<ref name="FireCarrier1" />}}
'''Section two-four-one''' was a section of a [[Arkinnea refugee camp|refugee camp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkinnea]],<ref name="FireCarrier1" /> founded around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="FireCarrierDate" /> to harbor refugees displaced by the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Section two-four-one&mdash;like the rest of the camp&mdash;was managed by the [[Arkinnea Militia]] under the supervision of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[K'Kruhk]] and were assigned to section two-four-one. After Jedi Master [[Zao]] arrived and warned the group of an imminent danger,<ref name="FireCarrier1" /> the group of Jedi left section two-for-one and the camp as a whole.<ref name="FireCarrier2">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 2|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Section two-four-one first appeared in [[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 1|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 1]],<ref name="FireCarrier1" /> the twenty-third issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' comic series published on [[February 6]], [[2013]]<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/19-789/Star-Wars-Dark-Times-Fire-Carrier-1|text=Star Wars: Dark Times&mdash;Fire Carrier #1}}</ref>
